name: y2kedit
description: Make your photos hopelessly Y2K: a browser photo editor with presets, stickers and chrome text (FastAPI + MongoDB + React).

scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
